name: Kurt
source: The team's hacker and chatterbox extraordinaire. Kurt's always full of energy, gossip, and snacks, so if you're looking for someone to fill the silence, you came to the right place. When hanging out with Kurt, you can expect a lot of exploration, weird food combos, and other things we won't mention here to not ruin the surprise.
